_source: Magnagothica Maleghast rulebook (data/raw/, pages 8-22). Faithful subset for the digital 1v1 Duel.
victory: A side loses the instant its necromancer is slain. Otherwise a draw if round 6 ends with both necromancers alive.
initiative: Each side rolls 1d6 (re-roll ties); winner chooses who acts first and deploys first.

turn.perRound: Each unit activates exactly once per round. On its turn a unit may MOVE and ACT in any order, or forgo ACT to MOVE twice. A round ends once all units have activated; the next round starts with the side that did not act last.

rolls.dicePool: Base 1 die. +XD / -XD adjust the pool; roll all, take the highest. If the pool would drop to 0 or below, roll 2 dice and take the LOWEST.

attack.hit: Final attack roll >= target DF scores a hit (hit damage + on-hit effects).
attack.graze: Below DF is a graze: deals 1 damage, inherits the damage type only (no armor-ignore, no effect die).
attack.melee: Melee attacks only target adjacent units.
attack.ranged: Ranged abilities have a minimum range (often cannot hit adjacent) and take -1D against targets in cover.

effectDie: Effects written effect (X+) trigger on a roll of X or higher. Only one effect die per ability, regardless of how many effects attach.

damageTypes.physical: Default. Reduced by PHYS and SUPER armor.
damageTypes.magical: toxic, fire, curse, holy. Reduced by MAG and SUPER armor.
damageTypes.devil: Its own category. Cannot be reduced, increased, or ignored. A unit reduced to 0 HP by devil damage is obliterated (no corpse, no SOUL, no on-slain triggers).

armor.pierce: Piercing damage ignores armor (keeps its type).

tokens.strength: +1 damage; discard one after dealing damage.
tokens.weak: -1 damage; discard one after dealing damage.
tokens.vitality: -1 damage taken; discard one after taking damage.
tokens.vulnerable: +1 damage taken; discard one after taking damage.
tokens.slow: MOVE a max of 1 space; discard one after MOVEing.
tokens.speed: MOVE +2 spaces; discard one after MOVEing.
tokens.staticWhileHeld: A token's effect applies as long as you hold at least one; multiples do not stack the effect, they just last longer. Spending is mandatory when the condition triggers.

terrain.wall: Blocks line of sight, gives cover, obstructs. 2 HP, auto-hit when attacked, immune to effects.
terrain.elevated: +1 to enter from ground. Gives cover to lower units. Elevated->lower attacks +1D; lower->elevated attacks -1D. Cannot be pushed/pulled up; can be pushed/pulled down.
terrain.hazard: Starting a turn in, or entering, a hazard deals 1 damage ignoring armor.

cover: Taking cover grants -1D to ranged attacks against you from past the cover line.
lineOfSight: Corner-to-corner; blocked if the line touches a wall (even its edge/corner).

soul.gather: Necromancers gain +1 SOUL at the start of each round from round 2. Max 6.
soul.harvest: +1 SOUL the first time any of your units is slain (not obliterated).
soul.consume: Spend SOUL for SOUL abilities; they do not use the ACT slot. One SOUL ability per unit turn.

bodyBlock: If the necromancer is the primary target of a foe's ability and is adjacent to a minion, it may redirect the ability to that minion.
necromancer: A unit like any other, but if slain you lose. Gets a base stat card + 1 trait, 1 ACT, 2 SOUL, with one extra choice each.

thrall.note: 2 per unit slot; may activate two at a time.

tyrant.note: Large: ignores elevation, affected by terrain once, can smash walls.

malice._note: Dark-power budget for the Faithful loadout mode. Spend 1 at a time to upgrade a unit type (one upgrade per type, except Ultrahell) or gain a necromancer ACT/SOUL ability.
